response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL AND link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), a AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM r) SELECT r.event_id, r.spend_ratio, r.spend_ratio / NULLIF(a.avg_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM r, a ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
